name: UCD Bot
tagline: A user-centred design teammate that runs a service from discovery to live

source.excerpt: Shared as a way to run public-sector-grade design practice without a full research team behind you.

body:
## What it does

Built on the practices set out by Nielsen Norman Group, the government service standard used across UK digital teams, and the DDaT capability framework. It carries a project through every phase, producing first-draft artefacts as it goes and keeping a traceable record of the evidence each decision rested on. It is built as a team of bots rather than a single one, so the roles stay separate.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @ucdco shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
